en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a quiet shoreline scene at Skeppsviken, Uddevalla. In the foreground three women in long dresses and hats stand by a narrow stream leading to a calm bay. Across the water are a few low buildings and, farther right, a tall‑masted sailing ship near steep rocky cliffs. Printed caption text appears at the top and along the right edge.
